history.summary: A 1BR penthouse with rooftop terrace at Katong Regency, a 2015 mixed-use development above retail in D15. Despite freehold tenure and a Paya Lebar location, the URA series (43 resale txns) shows -2.0%/yr appreciation and the unit is a niche, oversized penthouse type with shallow demand.
history.rating_rationale: $1.48M at $1,762 psf vs URA median $1,667 psf — listed ~6% above the development's own transacted median into a falling-price series (-1.98%/yr over 43 txns, a reliable count). 840 sqft 'penthouse' rents at only ~$4,500/mo (~3.6% gross on rent, far less net), and a 1BR penthouse is a thin buyer/tenant niche. Mixed-use blocks above retail historically lag pure-residential FH in appreciation.
red_flags: Negative URA appreciation -1.98%/yr across 43 reliable txns
Listed ~6% above development's own median PSF into a declining series
Niche 1BR penthouse layout — shallow resale and tenant pool
Mixed-use above retail — appreciation typically lags pure residential
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central commercial transformation, airbase relocation (long-dated)

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Penthouse 1BR rents ~$4,500/mo; the niche layout limits the tenant pool versus standard 1-2BR in the area. Gross yield modest after a sizeable purchase price for a single bedroom.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA resale-only data is unambiguous: -1.98%/yr over 43 transactions. Even discounting for noise, the trend is flat-to-down and the asking sits above the project's own median.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-only series (43 txns) adjusted modestly upward for FH/location; still negative-to-flat
